title: Yamamotoyama Premium Sencha Green Tea 100g
description_en: Established in 1690, Yamamotoyama is Japan's oldest tea company. This premium Sencha is hand-picked from first-flush spring harvests in Uji, Kyoto — the birthplace of Japanese green tea. Bright vegetal notes, low bitterness, clean finish.
description_ja: 1690年創業の日本最古のお茶屋・山本山のプレミアム煎茶。京都宇治産の一番茶を厳選。澄んだ緑色の水色と豊かな旨みが特徴。緑茶の聖地からお届けする逸品。
